notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines CMSG_GAMEOBJ_USE (bare full guid), CMSG_GAMEOBJECT_QUERY (entry + guid), and the SMSG_GAMEOBJECT_QUERY_RESPONSE parse (miss = entry|0x80000000; hit = type, display, name, 3 empty names + icon cstring, data[24], no trailing size float). MSUI matches all three byte-for-byte: WorldSession.GameObjectUse/GameObjectQuery and Program.GameObjects.ApplyGameObjectQuery.
